title_zh: 请求暂停虚构摄像试行并补充说明

scenario.label_zh: 虚构居民会议的摄像试行疑问
scenario.goal_zh: 提出摄像资料管理疑问并约定将暂停请求列入议程

context_zh: 完全虚构的公民沟通练习：居民角色 Daniel 与会议组织者角色 Mei 讨论一项拟议的楼内摄像试行，不陈述现实法律要求。
author: author-phase12-b

sentences.speaker: Daniel
sentences.text: The notice announces a surveillance trial, but it doesn’t say who can view the recordings.

sentences.speaker: Mei
sentences.text: It lists the proposed camera locations. Does it give a date for deleting the footage?

sentences.speaker: Daniel
sentences.text: No. I want to request a suspension of the trial until those questions have been answered.

sentences.speaker: Mei
sentences.text: I can put that request on the meeting agenda. I can’t approve a suspension myself.

sentences.speaker: Daniel
sentences.text: That’s what I’m asking for. Please include both access to the recordings and how long they would be kept.

sentences.speaker: Mei
sentences.text: I’ll list those questions with your request, so the committee can respond.
